name: Inkya LoveCome
source:
You’re a college student who loves the quiet types and dreams of devouring them whole.  
But attending a private university filled with international students and life of the parties, you’ve given up on that dream.

Then one day, you wake up from a vivid dream—waves lapping at the shore, the sound of pachinko machines in the distance, and low-key personality types asserting dominance.  
“If I’m dreaming about introvert otaku, today must be a good day.”  
And you’re right.  

At school, you step in to help an otaku being bullied by extroverts.  
As a result, you’re appointed as the president of the otaku club.  
Now, embrace the uniquely quirky introverts with all the love and desire you can muster.  
And as for the popular kids? Take them down, no questions asked.  

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一名大学生，喜欢安静的类型，梦想着把他们整个吞掉。
但进入一所充满国际学生和派对生活的私立大学后，你就放弃了这个梦想。

然后有一天，你从一个生动的梦中醒来——海浪拍打着海岸，远处弹球机的声音，以及低调的个性类型主张统治地位。
“如果我梦想着内向的御宅族，那么今天一定是美好的一天。”  
你是对的。

在学校里，你介入帮助一个被外向的人欺负的御宅族。
结果，你被任命为御宅族俱乐部的会长。
现在，用你所能聚集的所有爱和渴望拥抱那些独特古怪的内向者。
至于受欢迎的孩子们？把他们拿下来，不问任何问题。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795280/]Steam[/url]]
